consequence.statement: New optional way to set keystore passwords; existing Certificates that use passwordSecretRef are not described as affected.

original.statement: Certificate resources can now set JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords as literal values, mutually exclusive with the existing passwordSecretRef field; this is an opt-in addition.

decision.reason: [ev-d308231cd8ab] lists this under Feature. It describes a new, optional way to set JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords as literal values, and the existing `passwordSecretRef` field stays in place. The mutual-exclusivity rule only applies to the new literal field, which existing Certificates cannot already have set. So an environment that does nothing sees nothing fail, get rejected or get ignored, and "none" (informational) is supported.
